product.name: Slim-Fit Stretch Shirt
product.description: Slim-fit shirt in stretchy, woven cotton-blend fabric with a fitted silhouette. Cut-away collar, buttons without placket, and yoke at back. Long sleeves, sleeve placket with link button, and adjustable cuffs with buttons. Gently rounded hem.
